title: Idempotent stage_eval_mart + v_eval_mart_ym DDL
objective: Make etl4/run_e2e.py::stage_eval_mart idempotent. Reuse the existing IMPR-10 (ADR 2026-11-18) 18-column pivot shape and extend it with MAX(ym) AS last_ym (19 cols total). Watermark advance ('eval_mart','fact_experiment_result') runs in the same transaction as the COPY so a crash cannot leave the registry disagreeing with the mart. Also append CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_eval_mart_ym to etl4/infra/create_tables.sql for convenient (ym, source) dashboards.

files_changed.summary: stage_eval_mart: (a) CTE latest now selects pipeline_runs.ym; (b) outer SELECT adds MAX(l.ym) AS last_ym (pass-through aggregate - DISTINCT ON produces one row per cell); (c) DDL grows last_ym TEXT, DROP VIEW block drops v_eval_mart_ym + v_pareto_frontier in order; (d) view_ddl appends CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_eval_mart_ym matching the shape appended to create_tables.sql; (e) single psycopg transaction (autocommit=False) covers DROP/CREATE/COPY/watermark.set/view (re)creates so the watermark write and the layer write are atomic; (f) max_ym filtered to calendar YYYY-MM via _YM_CALENDAR_RE before watermark.set - SYN-* fails the CHECK regex and sorts after '2099-12' lexicographically which would both raise CheckViolation and hide calendar progress; (g) watermark tag printed in the OK line for operator visibility; (h) no stage ordering change - stage_eval_mart still runs last in STAGES.

Appended v_eval_mart_ym DDL at the tail (after pipeline_runs.ym block). Guarded via DO $$ IF EXISTS (information_schema.columns ...) $$ so applying on a fresh DB where stage_eval_mart has not yet created fact_experiment_result.last_ym does not raise (mirrors architecture.md R9 - v_pareto_frontier has the same latent dependency, intentionally left intact in this task). View shape: ym (aliased from last_ym), source, cells (count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = source)), slowest_wall_s (MAX(wall_secs)), mean_rmse_m (AVG FILTER NOT NULL), mean_seg_f1 (AVG FILTER NOT NULL). GROUP BY last_ym, source ORDER BY last_ym, source.

Live-Postgres smoke covering 6 ACs: stage runs, last_ym column present, view 6-col shape, view cardinality == count(DISTINCT (last_ym, source)), watermark row present with calendar ym and row_count matching mart, second invocation idempotent (fer/pareto/vem counts unchanged, updated_at strictly advances). Self-balancing assertions (before-vs-after) rather than hard-coded counts.

integration_points.reads: pipeline_runs (now including ym), eval_results (metrics for pivot), information_schema.columns (DO block guard for v_eval_mart_ym)
integration_points.writes: fact_experiment_result (19-col rewrite each run), v_pareto_frontier (CREATE OR REPLACE), v_eval_mart_ym (CREATE OR REPLACE; also created idempotently by stage_schema when fact_experiment_result.last_ym exists), pipeline_watermarks ('eval_mart','fact_experiment_result', calendar max_ym, len(df)), data/gold/marts/fact_experiment_result/part.parquet
callers_fixed_in_this_task: stage_eval_mart second invocation no longer DROPs v_eval_mart_ym with DependentObjectsStillExist (new view would otherwise block DROP TABLE on the second run - the same bug ADR 2026-11-18 fixed for v_pareto_frontier)

contract_deviations: ADR 2026-11-18 fixes fact_experiment_result at 18 columns. This task adds last_ym (19). Flagged for a follow-up ADR entry per architecture.md section 9.3 ('fact_experiment_result as table vs view - explicit partition-stage ADR after T-23'). Did NOT edit etl4/docs/decisions.md - it is outside the file list for this task.

Task spec listed v_eval_mart_ym with 'SELECT ym, source, ...'. The stored column is last_ym (per 'Extend fact_experiment_result DDL to include last_ym TEXT'); view aliases last_ym AS ym so the output schema matches AC-3 '6 columns' verbatim (first column named 'ym'). GROUP BY last_ym - works fine in PG with the output alias.

watermark row_count argument interpreted as the total mart row count (len(df)) since fact_experiment_result is not ym-partitioned (one row per (source, method, noise) cell, MAX(ym) across the pivoted months). Matches the 'advisory total' semantics documented in watermark.py.
risks: Pre-existing R9 widened: create_tables.sql now has two views (v_pareto_frontier, v_eval_mart_ym) that depend on fact_experiment_result. stage_schema on a fresh DB where stage_eval_mart has never run: v_pareto_frontier still fails (pre-existing), v_eval_mart_ym is guarded by DO block and skipped silently. Not fixed in this task; the architecture explicitly leaves R9 for a separate PR.

max_ym watermark is the max calendar ym across all pivoted cells, not per-cell. Operators reading the watermark see 'latest month any cell was measured from' which is approximately the full matrix horizon. If a specific (source, method, noise) cell lags behind another, the watermark does not surface that - the per-run last_ym column on fact_experiment_result does. v_eval_mart_ym exposes the per-(ym, source) view for ym-level dashboards.

pd.read_sql(..., psycopg_conn) emits a pandas UserWarning about SQLAlchemy connectable. Pre-existing behavior (not introduced by this task); non-fatal, does not affect correctness. A follow-up could switch to cur.execute + cur.fetchall + pd.DataFrame or an SQLAlchemy engine, but that's out of scope for T-23.
notes: Design choices: (a) MAX(l.ym) not grouped: DISTINCT ON picks one row per cell, so each GROUP BY tuple contains exactly one l.ym value - MAX is a pass-through aggregate that keeps last_ym describing the SAME run as run_id (e.g. s3/time_gap/N0 has runs 108 (2022-06) and 21 (2026-11); latest by started_at is 21, so last_ym=2026-11). (b) Single transaction via default autocommit=False ensures the watermark advance and the COPY commit atomically; in previous autocommit=True path, a crash between COPY and watermark would leave the registry stale. (c) v_eval_mart_ym definition is identical in run_e2e.py and create_tables.sql so CREATE OR REPLACE from either side never trips 'cannot change name/type of view column'. (d) DO block guard in create_tables.sql uses information_schema.columns (not pg_attribute) for standard SQL portability. (e) Smoke is self-balancing (before-vs-after assertions) so it passes regardless of how many pipeline_runs rows the DB has at the time; only requires at least one row for AC-4 cardinality >= 1.
